findings.title: Async sidecar construction mixes verified statement/digest with later mutable fields
findings.minimalCounterexample: Use a mutable serialized envelope and server-read draft. Pause crypto.subtle.digest on the second digest (statementDigest) after its input bytes were captured. While awaiting, set saved.statement.currency=JPY, period=2026-08 and envelope.digest=f*64; resume.
findings.observed: bindAgentMonthlyContract returns draft_only with the original USD/2026-09 statementDigest but JPY/2026-08 and an unverified f*64 snapshotDigest. invoiceCreated/collectionEnabled remain false; no financial effect executed.
findings.cause: saved/envelope/expected are retained across awaits. statementDigest captures JSON before the await; snapshotDigest/period/currency are read after it. Object.freeze freezes only the inconsistent result. The preview also rereads envelope.digest after asynchronous baseLineKey hashing.
findings.requiredCorrection: At entry, detach the complete saved statement/revision, envelope and expected consent context before any await; validate and hash that same snapshot, then derive every returned field from it or a verified immutable return. Apply the same rule to preview/verification boundaries that reread caller objects after await. Do not mutate caller inputs.
findings.acceptance: Controlled asynchronous input-mutation test for statement fields/revision/envelope/expected must produce the original internally consistent binding or reject, never a mixed digest/identity/period/currency. Existing frozen/serialized positive and wrong owner/currency/revision cases must still pass.
